title: Next Best Moves Agentic Interaction API Schema
description: Schema for agentic interaction when user accepts a Next Best Move from a signal

user_id.description: User ID who is accepting the next best move

next_best_move_index.description: Index of the next best move in the array (0-based)

next_best_move_text.description: The full text of the next best move question that user accepted
next_best_move_text.example: Would you like me to check how many of your target ICPs fall under the SMB segment and could be influenced by this move?

action.description: Action type - always 'accept_next_best_move' for this interaction

signal_context.description: Full signal context for agentic processing

description.description: Full signal description with ICP context

company_profile.description: Company profile data for context-aware agentic response

user_notes.description: Optional notes or comments from user
user_notes.example: Focus on North America market specifically

response_message.description: Agent's contextual response to the next best move question
response_message.example: Hi Alex, Noted. I'll check your pipeline and identify how many target ICPs fall under the SMB segment that could be influenced by Company X's pricing move. I'll analyze your current deals and provide a breakdown by segment.

action_items.description: List of action items the agent will perform

action.example: Analyze pipeline for SMB segment companies

items.example: Would you like me to also identify which of your current deals might be at risk?

data_insights.description: Any data insights generated by the agent

interaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this agentic interaction

AgenticMessage.description: Schema for sending additional messages in the agentic conversation

interaction_id.description: ID from the initial agentic response

message.example: Focus specifically on the North America market

accept_next_best_move.description: Endpoint for accepting a next best move and initiating agentic interaction

request.next_best_move_text: Would you like me to check how many of your target ICPs fall under the SMB segment and could be influenced by this move?

signal_context.headline: Competitor X launches SMB pricing tier.
signal_context.snippet: Likely to impact your ICP accounts in mid-market SaaS segment.
signal_context.description: This competitive pricing move by Company X directly impacts your SMB segment...

request.user_notes: Focus on North America market specifically

response.response_message: Hi Alex, Noted. I'll check your pipeline and identify how many target ICPs fall under the SMB segment (50-200 employees) that could be influenced by Company X's pricing move. Based on your company profile, I'll analyze your current deals in North America and Europe, and provide a breakdown showing which accounts might be at risk or could accelerate their decision timeline.

action_items.action: Analyze pipeline for SMB segment companies (50-200 employees)
Identify accounts in North America and Europe markets
Calculate impact percentage and risk assessment

follow_up_questions: Would you like me to also identify which of your current deals might be at risk?
Should I prepare competitive differentiation messaging for these accounts?
Do you want me to track early adoption signals from Company X?

data_insights.summary: Initial analysis shows 40% of your pipeline falls into the SMB segment
recommendations: Prioritize outreach to SMB accounts in final stages
Monitor Company X's early adoption metrics

send_agentic_message.description: Endpoint for sending additional messages in the agentic conversation

request.message: Focus specifically on the North America market

response.response_message: Understood. I'll focus the analysis specifically on the North America market. Let me filter the SMB segment companies to only those in North America and provide you with a targeted breakdown.

action_items.action: Filter pipeline analysis to North America market only

follow_up_questions: Would you like me to compare this with your European SMB segment as well?
Should I prepare region-specific messaging for North America accounts?

field_descriptions.next_best_move_index: The index (0-based) of which next best move in the array the user accepted. This allows the backend to know exactly which question the user wants answered.
field_descriptions.next_best_move_text: The full text of the next best move question. This is sent to ensure the backend knows exactly what question to answer, even if the array order changes.
field_descriptions.signal_context: Complete signal data to provide full context for the agentic response. The agent needs to understand the signal to provide relevant answers.
field_descriptions.company_profile: Company profile data helps the agent provide contextually relevant responses based on the user's ICP, target markets, and business goals.
field_descriptions.response_message: The agent's initial response should acknowledge the request and explain what it will do. Should be conversational and personalized.
field_descriptions.action_items: List of specific actions the agent will perform. Helps user understand what's happening and track progress.
field_descriptions.follow_up_questions: Suggested follow-up questions to continue the conversation and provide more value.
field_descriptions.interaction_id: Unique ID for this conversation thread. Used for subsequent messages in the same interaction.

step_1.description: User clicks 'Accept' on a Next Best Move
step_1.frontend_action: Calls POST /api/next-best-move/accept with signal context and next best move details

step_2.backend_action: Analyzes the next best move question, signal context, and company profile to generate intelligent response

response_includes: Action items the agent will perform

step_4.frontend_action: Calls POST /api/next-best-move/message with interaction_id and user message

step_5.backend_action: Continues conversation with context from previous messages

guidelines: Should be conversational and personalized (use user's name if available)
Should acknowledge the specific next best move question
Should explain what the agent will do
Should be contextually relevant to the signal and company profile
response_message.example_good: Hi Alex, Noted. I'll check your pipeline and identify how many target ICPs fall under the SMB segment (50-200 employees) that could be influenced by Company X's pricing move. Based on your company profile, I'll analyze your current deals in North America and Europe.

guidelines: Should relate directly to the next best move question
Should leverage company profile data (ICP, markets, goals)
Should be relevant to the current interaction
Should help user explore the signal deeper
